step.name: Step 1: Check Local Zoning Laws — This is foundational! Regulations for tiny homes, especially ADUs, vary a lot, even within San Diego County. You need to know if your specific property address falls under rules that permit tiny homes, whether on wheels or on a permanent foundation. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in navigating these local nuances.
step.text: Step 1: Check Local Zoning Laws — This is foundational! Regulations for tiny homes, especially ADUs, vary a lot, even within San Diego County. You need to know if your specific property address falls under rules that permit tiny homes, whether on wheels or on a permanent foundation. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in navigating these local nuances.

step.name: Step 2: Evaluate Site Access & Utilities — Can construction vehicles easily get to the build site? Is there existing access to water, power, and septic/sewer? Bringing new utilities to a difficult spot can add significant costs and complications.
step.text: Step 2: Evaluate Site Access & Utilities — Can construction vehicles easily get to the build site? Is there existing access to water, power, and septic/sewer? Bringing new utilities to a difficult spot can add significant costs and complications.

step.name: Step 3: Consider Topography & Drainage — Look at the lay of your land. Is it flat, sloped, or prone to flooding? This impacts foundation requirements, drainage planning, and overall site prep.
step.text: Step 3: Consider Topography & Drainage — Look at the lay of your land. Is it flat, sloped, or prone to flooding? This impacts foundation requirements, drainage planning, and overall site prep.

step.name: Step 4: Assess Space and Setbacks — Even if allowed, there are usually setback requirements from property lines, existing structures, and sometimes even trees. Does your property have enough clear space to accommodate the tiny home comfortably and legally?

step.name: Step 5: Get a Professional Site Feasibility Consultation — Honestly, this is the easiest way to avoid costly mistakes. A professional like Zen Tiny Homes can conduct a comprehensive review of all these factors, including land use planning, zoning codes, and utility mapping. We'll give you a clear picture of what's possible and what challenges might arise, helping you move from dream to a concrete plan.
